source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Weave a basic attack after every ability to cut your cooldowns, and spend Turbo Crunch on an empowered Right Crunch to knock them up. Once Spear Of Desolation is done near minute 16, use Re-Crunch to repeat your best hit.
offlane.issue: Re-Crunch repeats the LAST ability used, not a chosen 'best' hit
offlane.rewrite: Weave a basic attack after every ability to cut your cooldowns, and spend Turbo Crunch on an empowered Right Crunch to knock them up. Once Spear Of Desolation is done near minute 16, cast Re-Crunch right after your strongest ability, since it repeats the last ability you used.

offlane.quote: Trade with Hamstring on the lone laner and block their best ability with Safeguard. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, close with Reaping Dash and execute with Earth Shatter, since a takedown cuts the dash cooldown.
offlane.issue: muddled cause: 'execute with Earth Shatter, since a takedown cuts the dash cooldown' is a non-sequitur
offlane.rewrite: Trade with Hamstring on the lone laner and block their best ability with Safeguard. Once The Perforator is done near minute 16, close with Reaping Dash and execute with Earth Shatter; the takedown cuts Reaping Dash's cooldown so you can dash again.

jungle.quote: Gank with Stampede to drag them, then Smash 'n Grab to stun and Double Pain to heal while Bloodlust stacks. Once Viper lands near minute 16, use Warlord's Challenge to keep the fight going on stacked enemies.
jungle.issue: 'stacked enemies' is unclear (reads as grouped); the duration extension needs max Bloodlust stacks
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Stampede to drag them, then Smash 'n Grab to stun and Double Pain to heal while Bloodlust stacks. Once Viper lands near minute 16, use Warlord's Challenge on a hero with full Bloodlust stacks so hitting them keeps it going longer.

support.quote: Dekker wins this lane on our read; stop trading forward and keep Oil Spill to peel divers off your carry.
support.issue: "peel" is jargon a new player may not know
support.rewrite: Dekker wins this lane on our read; stop trading forward and keep Oil Spill to slow anyone who dives your carry.

jungle.quote: Jump in with Ambush to slow them, Unleash for fast attacks, and press Invigorate the moment you're stunned or slowed to cleanse and heal. With Alternator and Manta Scythe done, save Cull for grouped or fleeing enemies, since it stuns everyone in front of you.
jungle.issue: Invigorate cannot be pressed while stunned; telling players to cleanse a stun is misleading
jungle.rewrite: Jump in with Ambush to slow them, Unleash for fast attacks, and press Invigorate when you are slowed or low to cleanse and heal. With Alternator and Manta Scythe done, save Cull for grouped or fleeing enemies, since it stuns everyone in front of you.

offlane.quote: Trade with basic attacks to build Rage, Ambush when they're low since it hits harder on missing health, then Unleash and hold Invigorate to cleanse their stun. Once Manta Scythe and The Perforator are done, open fights with Cull on grouped enemies.
offlane.issue: Invigorate cannot be pressed while stunned; "cleanse their stun" is misleading
offlane.rewrite: Trade with basic attacks to build Rage, Ambush when they're low since it hits harder on missing health, then Unleash and hold Invigorate to cleanse their slows and heal. Once Manta Scythe and The Perforator are done, open fights with Cull on grouped enemies.

carry.quote: Stack Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy, then pop Dusk to burst everyone marked, using Shadow Glide to dodge and reset it on takedowns. As Deathstalker and Viper land, stand back and fire Purge once the fight is committed, since it also cuts their healing.
carry.issue: Purge only hits nearby enemies, so "stand back" contradicts how it works
carry.rewrite: Stack Vengeance with Wrath and Mercy, then pop Dusk to burst everyone marked, using Shadow Glide to dodge and reset it on takedowns. As Deathstalker and Viper land, fire Purge once the fight is committed and enemies are close, since it also cuts their healing.

carry.quote: Our read loses every listed carry lane, so farm near tower, avoid early trades, and wait for team fights to use Rally Point.
carry.issue: awkward phrasing ("Our read loses every listed carry lane")
carry.rewrite: Every listed carry wins this lane on our read, so farm near tower, avoid early trades, and save Rally Point for team fights.

jungle.quote: Clear camps with Clobber so Extract keeps your health up, then gank by channeling Abduct from fog and following with Beguile. Once Orion and Noxia are done, cast Eclipse before an objective fight so the enemy can't see your team coming.
jungle.issue: "from fog" is jargon a new player may not know
jungle.rewrite: Clear camps with Clobber so Extract keeps your health up, then gank by channeling Abduct from out of sight and following with Beguile. Once Orion and Noxia are done, cast Eclipse before an objective fight so the enemy can't see your team coming.

support.quote: Land Data Burst on whoever dives your carry, and save an Overclocked Data Burst to mesmerize them as well as slow them. As Warp Stream and Stonewall finish, use Final Thread in fights so L.I.N.X and Data Burst keep peeling for your carry.
support.issue: "peeling" is jargon a new player may not know
support.rewrite: Land Data Burst on whoever dives your carry, and save an Overclocked Data Burst to mesmerize them as well as slow them. As Warp Stream and Stonewall finish, use Final Thread in fights so L.I.N.X and Data Burst keep enemies off your carry.

offlane.quote: Trade with Scar first so their bruiser gets rooted when the stacks run out, then back off while Fate reloads. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to isolate their carry in team fights instead of their frontline.
offlane.issue: Scar roots when your hits use up the stacks, not when they run out on their own
offlane.rewrite: Hit their bruiser with Scar and keep shooting so the stacks are used up and they get rooted, then back off while Fate reloads. Once Plasma Blade and Deathstalker are done, use Reckoning to isolate their carry in team fights instead of their frontline.

jungle.quote: Khaimera, Kwang and Rampage win the straight duel, so skip their camps and gank lanes instead of fighting them in the jungle.
jungle.issue: names Rampage, who is not in the lane matchups
jungle.rewrite: Khaimera and Kwang win the straight duel, so skip their camps and gank lanes instead of fighting them in the jungle.

offlane.quote: If Greystone or Steel survives your combo you have no escape left, so leave with your saved Rushing Beat instead of staying.
offlane.issue: contradicts itself: says no escape left, then says leave with saved Rushing Beat
offlane.rewrite: If Greystone or Steel survives your combo, don't stay to finish; leave with the Rushing Beat charge you saved.

midlane.quote: Poke with Plasma Grenade and Atomiser from range, and only turn on Hypercharge when a target is low enough to finish. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Air Assault to fight from above and look for kills in side lanes.
midlane.issue: misleading: uses the Atomiser finisher as poke and holds back Hypercharge, the core damage tool of this build
midlane.rewrite: Poke with Plasma Grenade from range, turn on Hypercharge to trade, and save Atomiser to finish a low target. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Air Assault to fight from above and look for kills in side lanes.

offlane.quote: Pull in with Lash Kick, then chain basic attacks to proc Windburn and stack Rising Storm; use Backlash to push them away when they fight back. After Mutilator and The Perforator by minute 17, use Quelling Gale in team fights.
offlane.issue: wrong timing: The Perforator is done ~minute 16, not 17
offlane.rewrite: Pull in with Lash Kick, then chain basic attacks to proc Windburn and stack Rising Storm; use Backlash to push them away when they fight back. After Mutilator and The Perforator by minute 16, use Quelling Gale in team fights.
